verdict.rationale: CMS IndusLaw is a full-service law firm, not a software product, platform, or tool. Connecting an agent through an official MCP server is a category error for a professional legal-services provider, and nothing in the pack shows the firm ships any MCP or agent-facing interface. The llms.txt probe returned a 404, which also points to no agent-facing surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
